logoResearch.method: Opened current named dealer profile and three seller-bound LicensePlate stock listings; searched public catalogues and exact trading names, and retrieved the current named public catalogue profile and its attributable original dealer image.
logoResearch.result: Original public raster was small or opaque and needed a full clean transparent redraw. Identity and dealer city were compared with the retained lead; original name, palette and motif are preserved with surface-specific contrast adjustments.

visualReview: Faithful blue-disc and vintage-roadster identity with stronger gold strokes and bold BADAR USED CARS wording. Flat deep blue/gold on white and light blue/gold on dark/accent. No founding-year claim is added; the source slogan is omitted from the redraw. At32px the vintage-car/circle silhouette is the identity cue.
